addr.name: gameStateBase
addr.evidence: fieldID(0x8006F94E)-0x231A; gameState pointer loaded from 0x8005A39C in field-module init, fieldVars read at +0x1930
addr.desc: Game state struct base. Pointer to it lives at gameStatePtr.

addr.name: gameStatePtr
addr.evidence: field_module init: lw a0,-0x5c64(0x8006xxxx) then lhu v0,0x1930(a0) (fieldVars)
addr.desc: Kernel global holding the gameState base pointer.

addr.name: fieldID
addr.evidence: boot dispatcher READ 0x8001b7a8: (fieldID&0x7FF)<0x400 -> module 1 Field else module 3 Worldmap; WRITE 0x8001b7ec sets 490 (title screen)
addr.desc: gameState+0x231A. Current field/map ID. >=0x400 selects worldmap module.

addr.name: gold
addr.evidence: FUN_8001c1a8 (native debug menu): DAT_8006ef58 = 999999999
addr.desc: gameState+0x1924. Money.

addr.name: fieldVars
addr.evidence: field-module init copies 512 u16 from gameState+0x1930 to local mirror 0x800C3A68
addr.desc: gameState+0x1930. 512 script variables; var[0]=GameProgress, var[2]=field entry point (see flags.xml).

addr.name: partyMemberBitField
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384 (battle module): read as mask together with partyFrameMask
addr.desc: gameState+0x1D30. Bitmask of unlocked party members.

addr.name: partyFrameMask
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: ANDed with partyMemberBitField
addr.desc: gameState+0x1D32. Second party availability mask.

addr.name: kernelPartySlots
addr.evidence: kernel sync 0x800A3200 copies these u32s (low byte) into currentParty every frame; live write of slot0=2 persisted and gameState+vars followed
addr.desc: MASTER party representation (field kernel BSS). Low byte = char id, 0xFF = empty. Write HERE, not currentParty.

addr.name: currentParty
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: iterates 0x8006F368..0x8006F36A, value&0x7F; live: per-frame copy of kernelPartySlots (writes reverted)
addr.desc: gameState+0x1D34. Active party character IDs (see characters.xml), 0xFF=empty. READ-ONLY mirror of kernelPartySlots — direct writes are reverted by the kernel sync.

addr.name: partyRoster
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: memcpy(0xA4) from charId*0xA4+0x8006D8A0 per party member
addr.desc: gameState+0x26C. 11 character records of 0xA4 bytes (stats/level/equipment).

addr.name: gearRoster
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: gearId*0xA4+0x8006DFAC
addr.desc: gameState+0x978. 20 gear records of 0xA4 bytes.

addr.name: battleEntities
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: destination buffer filled per party member, stride 0x170
addr.desc: Battle entity slots (11 x 0x170 bytes), battle module BSS.

addr.name: battleModuleOverlay
addr.evidence: battle module loads at 0x8015F000-0x801F3FFF; contains battle setup entry FUN_801e5384
addr.desc: Battle module load region (informational, not a writable variable).

addr.name: cameraMatrix
addr.evidence: field-module init calls matrix-init util 0x80070594(0x800AF990)
addr.desc: g_cameraMatrix (field module).

addr.name: projectionMatrix
addr.evidence: field-module init: second matrix-init call at 0x800AF990+0xD4
addr.desc: g_currentProjectionMatrix (field module).

addr.name: cameraEye
addr.evidence: WRITE in FUN_00021fe0 (field_module), READ at 0x5a0c
addr.desc: g_cameraEye (field module). Free-camera write target.

addr.name: cameraAt
addr.evidence: WRITE in FUN_00021c00 and at 0x21ef0 (field_module)
addr.desc: g_cameraAt (field module). Free-camera write target.

addr.name: actorArrayPtr
addr.evidence: lw in FUN_000320e8 (field_module)
addr.desc: Pointer to the field actor array.

addr.name: nativeDebugMenuEnable
addr.evidence: FUN_8001c1a8 gates the Menu=(%d)%s debug menu list on DAT_80059178 != 0
addr.desc: Nonzero enables the game's native Kernel debug menu list at boot.

addr.name: moduleSwitchFn
addr.evidence: jal 0x8001996c in boot dispatcher; a0=module id (1=Field,2=Battle,3=Worldmap,4=Battling,5=Menu,6=Movie)
addr.desc: module_switch(int module_id) - informational.

addr.name: fieldMapNumber
addr.evidence: write target id here; poll computes (id&0xFFF)*2 as bundle file index. Confirmed: intro writer sw 4; gear-state reads &0xFFF
addr.desc: TELEPORT TARGET. The map-change request channel.

addr.name: teleportGate1
addr.evidence: poll gate at 0x80078498: must be 0; idle is 0xFFFFFFFF and BLOCKS the poll if not cleared. The door handler clears it (sw zero,-9236(0x800B))
addr.desc: RECIPE: write 0.

addr.name: fieldChangePrevented
addr.evidence: idle 0xFF/-1; must be exactly 0 to arm (reference: door opcode clears it)
addr.desc: RECIPE: write 0.

addr.name: teleportArm
addr.evidence: poll gate at 0x800784BC: must equal s3 (0xFF, set at 0x80078170); idle is already 0xFF in free-roam
addr.desc: RECIPE: write 0xFF (usually already 0xFF in free-roam; write defensively).

addr.name: teleportGateMusic
addr.evidence: poll gate at 0x800784A8: must be 0 (usually already 0)
addr.desc: RECIPE: write 0 defensively.

addr.name: teleportGateAnim
addr.evidence: poll gate at 0x800784D0: must be 0 (usually already 0)
addr.desc: RECIPE: write 0 defensively.

addr.name: loadNewFieldFn
addr.evidence: async bundle fetcher (file = index+0xB8); returns 0 when resident, -1 busy; D_8004F330=fileIndex while loading. NOT reentrant - let the poll call it
addr.desc: Informational only - do not call directly.

addr.name: fieldEntryPointFn
addr.evidence: field module entry (module jump table [1]); contains the per-frame teleport poll at 0x800784A0
addr.desc: Informational only.
